style: Botanical game sprites: each cell is a straight-on orthographic side view (elevation) of a whole plant, natural daylight, realistic.

cells.name: oak_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a mature broad oak tree with a thick trunk and a full rounded crown; the trunk base touches the bottom margin.

cells.name: jungle_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a tall tropical rainforest tree with buttress roots, a slender trunk, hanging lianas and a broad dense crown; the base touches the bottom margin.

cells.name: bush_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a dense round green shrub with no visible trunk, sitting on the bottom margin.

cells.name: pine_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a snow-dusted spruce with tiered drooping branches and snow lying on the branches, narrow conical shape; the trunk base touches the bottom margin.

cells.name: palm_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a coconut palm with a gently curved slender trunk, drooping fronds and a cluster of coconuts; the trunk base touches the bottom margin.

cells.name: wheat_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a dense clump of ripe golden wheat stalks with heavy ears, spreading across the full cell width, stems reaching the bottom margin.

cells.name: corn_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a row of three tall green corn (maize) plants with long arching leaves, ears and tassels; stems reach the bottom margin.

cells.name: fern_side
cells.prompt: Side view of a lush green fern with long fronds arching up and out from a single base at the bottom margin.

cells.name: leaf
cells.prompt: A loose cluster of about forty overlapping fresh green leaves of various sizes and shades, seen from above, no stems sticking out.
